_comment: Disable SIP by appending csr-active-config. Apply with: python tools/nvramdump.py <vm>.nvram --rebuild out.nvram tools/nvram-edits/csr-disable.json  (the VM must be powered off). Value ff000000 is read little-endian => CSR_ALLOW_UNTRUSTED_KEXTS plus every other allow bit. If csrutil still reports enabled after a boot, retry with 7f000000 (what `csrutil disable` writes) to tell 'record ignored' apart from 'wrong bit'.
